title: fix(image): reject transparent background requests for z-image-turbo
author: Saauf

gist.summary: Requests for `zimage` (`tongyi-mai/z-image-turbo`) with `transparent=true` are rejected with HTTP 400 instead of returning an opaque JPEG with HTTP 200; its self-hosted backend does not support alpha output. Transparency support is recorded in the shared image-model registry, with validation handled centrally rather than in individual model implementations. The `polli-cli` `--transparent` help text now says the flag works only with select models.
